category_title: At-risk students balancing full-time employment and parental responsibilities
minimal_context: The student is asked to complete a reading assignment during a short four-hour school session.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Please take out your assignment and finish the reading questions for today's class.

STUDENT: I didn't get to finish it before school. I had to work my full-time job yesterday and then take care of my child all night.

TUTOR: Try to read it now and answer what you can.

STUDENT: I'm trying, but it's really hard to joggle among work, family responsibilities, and school. Sometimes when I doubt myself, I just feel like I can't catch up.

TUTOR: Just keep working on the questions on your worksheet.

STUDENT: I can't even concentrate on this right now. I doubt I'm going to pass anyway, so I'm just going to pack up and leave early today.

options.A: Terminate the academic demands and remove the reading worksheet for ten seconds.
options.B: Remove the pen-to-paper component and allow the student to use an iPad app.
options.C: Ignore the student's behavior and statements, where it is safe to do so.
options.D: Provide personal encouragement and share positive statements with the student.
